summary: X4 Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a new $150M senior secured credit facility with K2 HealthVentures and other lenders, executed October 7, 2026. The first tranche of $80M funded at close, used to repay the Hercules loan and for working capital; a $70M second tranche is subject to lender discretion. Pricing is the greater of 8.55% or prime+1.55%, plus 1% PIK and a final payment fee. Interest-only through October 2029, with maturity October 1, 2030. The facility is collateralized by substantially all assets. Watch for lender consent risk and milestone achievement for payment extension.
